Using a ligand-field analysis (via Tanabe-Sugano calculations) and constrained by the given ratio $C/B = 4.6$, the observed transition energies are fitted to the theoretical energy levels.

- The crystal-field parameter **$Dq \approx 2,716\text{ cm}^{-1}$**

2. $^2T_{2g} \to ^2T_{1g} \approx 22,931\text{ cm}^{-1}$ (Observed: $22,930\text{ cm}^{-1}$)
3. $^2T_{2g} \to ^2T_{2g}' \approx 25,080\text{ cm}^{-1}$ (Observed: $25,080\text{ cm}^{-1}$)

These results provide an excellent fit to the experimental data.
